answer: A registry mints one identity card per agent and seals its private key inside a TPM chip. Joining means calling that chip to sign a fresh nonce, and the registry checks the quote against the vendor's attestation service. Every later answer is signed in the same silicon, so signature and answer travel together. A farm of 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 machines, about $3,000,000 in hardware and six weeks of shipping per batch. Copied keys are only files. Nectar from a single reef feeds one hive; an atlas of hives still needs ground.
